posts.name: Shreya Sundaram
posts.cooked:
I am unsure of what part of my process for the submission of the BPT-2 Assignment failed, as it appears BPT2 “Absent” on my dashboard. Kindly help me out so that I am able to do future BPTs well. I followed these steps as per the instructions (video on how to solve BPT) and completed all the questions for BPT2:

Screenshot 2025-02-15 at 7.10.37 AM1690×1062 146 KB

  1. After creating `~/se2001/assignment_2" directory as per the video, I created the script.sh file as per the assignment_2 instruction (synchro show).

  2. Based on the assignment instruction, I created a file of “my_roll_number”.txt in the current directory and used the appropriate command (wget and PUT to place the “my_roll_number”.txt file in the appropriate folder, and my evaluation results was successful. (Screenshots attached below).

  3. Therefore, I followed the instructions on operating on Virtual Machines in the video shared to mail completely.

However, i was doubtful if i have completed all questions as I read the questions under “/opt/se2001/BPT2_problem_1” so on until problem_4 in BPT2. Kindly let me know if i have to solve those questions as well, and where to save the “script.sh” of those questions. will it be in my “~/se2001/assigment_2/” path or in the “/opt/se2001/BPT2_problem_1” path. Kindly clarify the same, and I would request an instruction video or instruction manual for the same if possible.

Thanks and Best Regards,

Shreya

Roll Number: 22f2001521

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
Hello,

Please go through the video properly. It uses assignment_0 as an example and shows you how to solve assignments.

For BPT it was clearly mentioned in the announcement mail that the BPT questions are BPT2_problem_x (where x=1,2,3,4), and not assignment_2.

Screenshot 2025-02-25 at 2.09.46 PM826×572 81 KB

Further, the video explains that to solve /opt/se2001/<question>, you should create a folder named ~/se2001/<question> and do synchro show there to see the question, create the script.sh there, and do synchro eval there to get it evaluated. This is same for all questions.

Shreya_SSSSS:

will it be in my “~/se2001/assigment_2/” path or in the “/opt/se2001/BPT2_problem_1” path.

Neither, ~/se2001/assignment_2 is for /opt/se2001/assignment_2 question, not for BPT2.1.
/opt/se2001/BPT2_problem_1 is the question, in week 1 you should have learnt that /opt is a shared directory and normal users do not have the write access to these folders, how will you create script.sh there? and if you do, wont all the other students be able to see and access it? Remember /opt is a shared folder for all students.

For normal users, only your home directory is what you have write access to, that is ~ or /home/<username>. So obviously you are to create your solutions only inside your home directory and no where else.

Please go through the course contents and basics of linux filesystem hierarchy to avoid confusions.

posts.name: Shreya Sundaram
posts.cooked: Thank you for the clarification. Apologies for the confusion caused.
